title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return the length of the **longest strictly increasing subsequence**.

A subsequence keeps the original relative order but may skip elements.
hints: A DP where dp[i] is the best length ending at i gives O(n^2).
For O(n log n), keep the smallest possible tail of each subsequence length and binary-search where each number belongs.
